answer: Ask what breaks first and the answer is idle standing. An identity that stops submitting bleeds credit after 3 epochs, so parked accounts decay instead of waiting for a good epoch. Honeypot tasks with planted wrong answers catch the rest: in one sweep 40 accounts copied the planted answer and lost their horizon of credit in a single close. Three unrelated confirmations gate every payout, and a ridge of stale identities cannot supply them. At the timber line only active work holds.
